Then I tried doing an extra little step during removal which made all the difference. I really like these.  I use them on my daughter, who is 9 and has very fine hair.  These hold her hair in a ponytail all through the school day or through a dance class.  It does take some patience to remove, but I see that as a fair trade off for something that holds so well

reviews.t: Perfect for my straight shoulder length, thick, fine hair
reviews.x: It sounds like there is quite a bit of displeasure out there, thought it would be a good time to send a review. I have used a single pack for months now with none of them failing or breaking my hair. I have a thick head of fine straight hair and absolutely adore them. They are the ONLY type of hair elastic that I have ever found that doesn't immediately slide right back out when I put up a pony tail. I guess if your hair is different from mine your milage will vary. I love them.

These hold really well, but I have waist length hair, and getting them in and out is a challenge because the silicon grabs on. My hair wraps around them, and a couple of times when I have finally extricated them, the broken hair wrapped around them cut through them when I tried to clear it off. I think they would be awesome for shorter hair, though, they really hold in place.

reviews.t: Can’t go wrong with a Scunci!
reviews.x: I absolutely love these and am disheartened I can’t find locally lately.  I’m a fan of the gel rubber bands but feel these do a better job holding my thin hair in place.  Price is higher than I normally pay, but happy to this one time.  Shipping could have been faster imo but I didn’t let that affect my rating because I knew in advance it would be.

reviews.t: Great for a Search & Rescue Tracking Pole
reviews.x: My hair is too short to use for the intended purposes. These work great on my folding tent pole that functions as a SAR tracking stick. It helps me mark the length, width and stride of the tracks that I am following. Easy to see, hold in place, and reposition when needed.
Expected a nice assortment of "adult" colors as shown (navy, red, black, white, purple).  Instead received bright neon colors of yellow, pinks and turquoise that I will never wear.  Gave them away.

My 3 year old loves the look of pigtails and ponytails, but she hates how tight the tiny disposable silicone rubber bands get (it hurt!).  Fabric wrapped elastics just slide right out of her slippery hair, even the Goody non-slip kind.  We stopped trying pigtails at all until we found these.  They're perfect for her, since they don't slide, I don't have to twist and wrap them multiple times to get them tight enough, and her hair is a great texture for just rolling these out at the end of the day

reviews.t: Great for my type of hair!

Because my curly hair is also layered to keep the curl, the amount of hair needed to be pulled back can be very small.  These bands I stretch over my thumb and pointer finger, grab the small amount of hair and pull it through and it holds! They keep my hair pulled back without falling out and a lot better than the small bands that tear my hair out when removing the tiny bands.  These do 🚫. My hair is thinning and these bands really hold well in spite of it.
Not bad but we found out they break after a few uses

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these elastics for holding hair securely in place, especially for fine or slick hair that other holders fail to keep up.
Many reviewers report that removal is difficult and can rip or break hair, requiring patience or a special technique.
Several reviewers received the wrong colors, with neon shades sent instead of the advertised assortment.
Some reviewers find the elastics hard to stretch and note that they grab and wrap around long hair during removal.
A few reviewers mention the bands work well for fine hair and even serve as a cat toy.
